title: About
text: I was drawn to data science after completing a handful of data and informatics courses during my undergrad. In particular, my INFO 419 (I believe) course was very inspiring. We learned all about information processing and ethics, and I found myself wanting to learn more and more about data practices. Outside of school, I am an avid reader and rugby player! Beyond that, I found myself lacking enough time to pursue my other hobbies such as drawing and painting. I do hope to pick these back up once I finish this degree:)

title: Delaney Woods
text:
My name is Delaney Woods, and I grew up in Victoria located on Vancouver Island. I studied in the BMS program at UBC prior to commencing the MDS program and I am hoping to learn a great deal about data structures and appropriate data practices to eventually work in the data ethics field! (Maybe in healthcare, maybe in sports science, who knows!:)
